how_long.Text: How long have you been on Rubi-Ka?

Text: {delay 1}Oh, don't bother about me, I am just watching the colonists arrive. Reminds me of my first meeting with Rubi-Ka. It wasn't the same back then, of course. There's a lot more traffic now, and life's become so much harder. Just yesterday I saw this young couple from Taku. They looked so happy and hopeful. I hope they know what they're getting themselves into. Rubi-Ka can be a very dangerous place.

how_long.Text: Most of my life. I arrived from Earth when I was sixteen years old, and I hated it! On Earth, I had my friends, the malls and entertainment complexes - I lived in Bombay - and one or two handsome suitors. On Rubi-Ka, there was nothing, at first. But I grew to love it. And now I would never want to live anywhere else.
